name: CBaseManaged

name: CCamera
meaning: Holds a camera: the property slots and update list, then nine properties

name: CInputControl
meaning: Holds the world input state: held commands, travel sums, times and the armed click

name: CMovement
meaning: Holds a unit's movement: the shared kinematics to +0xab, then collision size, relay timing, event queue and unit

name: CPlayerMoveEvent
meaning: Holds one queued movement event: list link, time, tag, pose, status snapshot, payload and flags

name: ClientConnection
meaning: Holds the world session: a RealmConnection with the status the screens poll

name: ClientLink
meaning: Holds the logon link: its connection, state, receive buffer, SRP6 object and owner

name: EvtContext
meaning: Holds a scheduled context: its run state, due time, flags, handler lists, messages, held input and timers

name: EvtHandler
meaning: Holds a registered handler: its link, function, argument, priority and skip flag

name: ITEMCOOLDOWNHASHNODE

name: NETEVENTQUEUENODE

name: NTempest::CRndSeed

name: RACECLASSINFO
meaning: Holds a race-class index node: skill line, two links, and a run of SkillRaceClassInfo rows

name: SKILLCOSTSINFO
meaning: Holds a skill-cost index node: cost-set id, two links, and a run of SkillCostsData rows

name: SKILLLINEREC
meaning: Holds an ability index node: spell, two links, race, class and a SkillLineAbility row

name: SPELLHISTORY

name: Shard
meaning: Holds one shard: link, position, model, start time and started flag

name: SpellCastTimesRec
meaning: Holds one SpellCastTimes.dbc row: id, base, per-level and minimum cast time in ms

name: SpellDurationRec
meaning: Holds one SpellDuration.dbc row: id, duration, per-level duration and maximum in ms

name: SpellRangeRec
meaning: Holds one SpellRange.dbc row: id, minimum and maximum range, flags and names

name: SpellRec
meaning: Holds one Spell.dbc row

name: WowConnection
meaning: Holds one socket connection: state, handler, receive buffer, send queue and header cipher
